name: portfolio
description: MimiOS is a browser-based desktop operating system built with React, TypeScript, and a custom virtual filesystem. Featuring a Linux-inspired desktop, liquid glass UI, interactive apps, a secure admin portal, and MimiAI powered by NVIDIA NIM. Built to blend personal portfolio, AI-assisted interaction, and cybersecurity into one desktop experience.

paragraphs: A browser-based desktop operating system & interactive developer portfolio. Reimagining personal portfolio discovery through a Linux-inspired desktop environment, virtual filesystem, terminal shell, and an AI-driven cybersecurity companion.
Quick Links: Live Demo • Frontend Repository • Backend Repository • Issue Tracker
features: Fluid Windowing System: Multi-window window manager built with Zustand (useWindowStore), supporting cascade positioning, snapping, boundary-clamped dragging, and resizable edges.
Liquid Glass Aesthetic: Translucent dark surfaces with customizable backdrop blur (0px to 30px, defaulting to 5px), subtle border highlights, and dark-theme contrast.
State Preservation: Minimizing or backgrounding an application preserves component state without remounting.
Quick-Access Launcher: Searchable directory of all installed applications, categorized into system utilities, portfolio views, and entertainment.
Active Taskbar: Visual indicator for running apps, active focus highlights, and one-click minimize/restore.

whatItDoes.text: A browser-based desktop operating system & interactive developer portfolio. Reimagining personal portfolio discovery through a Linux-inspired desktop environment, virtual filesystem, terminal shell, and an AI-driven cybersecurity companion.

requirements.text: Session Authentication: Integrates with backend signed cookie sessions (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, /api/auth/me).
Network-dependent features (MimiAI chat, remote GitHub sync, and Admin Portal login) will cleanly display friendly connection notices.
